October 15, 2026


As presenting sponsor of Step Up for Mental Health, Cameco was inspired to see a record 8,091 participants register, representing more than 230 Saskatchewan communities and seven provinces. More than 400 Cameco employees and family members took part as runners and volunteers last weekend, and our own senior vice-presidents Lisa Aitken and Rachelle Girard were honoured to hand out medals at the finish line. Thank you to everyone who showed up, laced up and helped raise awareness and support for mental health programs across our province.[#MentalHealth](https://facebook.com/hashtag/MentalHealth)[#StepUpForMentalHealth](https://facebook.com/hashtag/StepUpForMentalHealth) #CommunitySupport
